names.note: Name page 14954 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Даниил (Кушнир) Черкасский, мч.»; the grade is stripped and both the surname and the epithet kept, that being the fullest form the calendar gives. The day line itself gives «Даниила Черкасского» without the surname. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and a Cyrillic grep for «Кушнир» over every `saint.json` returns nothing.

death.note: The day line closes «(1766)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июля ст. ст. — «Мч. Даниила Черкасского (1766).»

attestations.note: The day's ninth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line and name page 14954 agree on «мч.», martyr, with no rank in the church, so `martyr` is all that is written and NO `office` IS WRITTEN; `new-martyr` was not written either, 1766 being two centuries before anything this corpus calls that. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*kushnir*` and `*cherkas*` return nothing of this name. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
